'''''Damasonium bourgaei''''' is a species of plant in the family [[Alismataceae]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Damasonium bourgaei Coss. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/1087350|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Damasonium bourgaei'' (Mediterranean Starfruit Plantain): MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/ALSM/Damasonium_bourgaei.php|access-date=2022-02-16|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>

== Distribution ==
''Damasonium bourgaei'' has a scattered distribution in the [[Mediterranean Basin]], occurring in [[Algeria]], [[Cyprus]], [[Egypt]], [[Greece]], [[Israel]], [[Syria]], [[Sicily]] and [[Sardinia]], [[Malta]], [[Morocco]], [[Portugal]], [[Spain]], [[Tunisia]], and [[India]].<ref name=iucn /><ref name="rich">{{cite journal |last1=Rich |first1=T.C.G. |last2=Nicholls-Vuille |first2=F.L. |title=Taxonomy and distribution of European ''Damasonium'' (Alismataceae) |journal=Edinb. J. Bot. |date=2001 |volume=58 |issue=1 |pages=45–55 |doi=10.1017/S0960428601000464|doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Rodríguez García |first1=A. |title=''Damasonium bourgaei'' Coss. (Alismataceae), novedad corológica para Castilla y León (España) |journal=Acta Botanica Malacitana |date=2019 |volume=44 |pages=73–75 |doi=10.24310/abm.v44i0.5321 |doi-access=free|hdl=10630/18836 |hdl-access=free }}</ref>

== Ecology ==
''D. bourgaei'' is an amphibious [[Annual plant|annual]] plant associated with habitats that undergo [[Vernal pool|seasonal changes]] in the water level, usually on nutrient-rich substrates.<ref name=iucn /> The species produces different types of leaves depending on the water depth, including  grass-like submerged leaves, floating spoon-shaped leaves or, in its terrestrial phase, emergent lanceolate leaves.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Talavera |first1=S. |last2=Talavera |first2=M.M. |editor1-last=Talavera |editor1-first=S. |editor2-last=Gallego |editor2-first=M.J. |editor3-last=Romero Zarco |editor3-first=C. |editor4-last=Herrero |editor4-first=A. |title=Flora Iberica: Plantas vasculares de la Península Ibérica e Islas Baleares. Vol. XVII. Butomaceae-Juncaceae |date=2010 |publisher=Real Jardín Botánico, CSIC |location=Madrid |isbn=978-84-00-09112-5 |pages=18–22 |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/17_161_03_Damasonium.pdf |chapter=''Damasonium'' Mill.}}</ref>

Contrary to most other ''Damasonium'' species, the flowers of ''D. bourgeai'' have [[anther]]s that touch the [[carpels]], facilitating [[self-pollination]].<ref name="Vuille">{{cite journal |last1=Vuille |first1=F.-L. |title=Reproductive biology of the genus ''Damasonium'' (Alismataceae) |journal=Pl. Syst. Evol. |date=1987 |volume=157 |pages=63–71 |doi=10.1007/BF00939181}}</ref>
